recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant group portrait of four men positioned at the bottom of the frame against a high-contrast orange and yellow sunburst background, topped by a prominent metallic, automotive-style chrome emblem containing bold typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The sunburst radiates from a central point behind the subjects, drawing focus to the group.
The heavy chrome emblem at the top balances the visual weight of the figures at the bottom.
The saturated primary colors of the clothing contrast sharply with the warm background tones.
coreInvariants: Radial sunburst pattern with alternating orange and yellow rays.
Beveled chrome texture on all graphic elements.
Low-angle or eye-level group composition with heads clustered together.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects occupy the bottom third of the frame, appearing as a tight-knit group from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large chrome emblem at the top center serves as the primary graphic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright chrome logo, follows the sunburst rays down to the faces, and scans across the varied expressions of the group.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The middle section is dominated by the graphic sunburst, providing breathing room between the logo and the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Orange and yellow sunburst creates a high-energy, warm atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool blues and deep reds in the clothing provide a break from the warm background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver/Chrome provides a neutral but high-specular highlight.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with high-value highlights on the chrome to simulate metallic reflection.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muted or pastel tones; maintain high-energy saturation.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, wide sans-serif with squared-off terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Integrated into a pill-shaped metallic frame with a top 'hood' detail
Deep 3D beveling with anisotropic chrome reflections
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first and last letters are partially integrated into the outer frame border.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The chrome logo is the sole typographic element, paired only with the photographic subjects.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, industrial, square-jawed feel of the base characters.
Provides the necessary geometric and tech-inspired structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast radial sunburst background with alternating orange and yellow rays. In the bottom foreground, place a group of four men in late 90s fashion (bright shirts, sunglasses, spiky hair) looking at the camera.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, custom-lettered chrome emblem at the top. The lettering should be bold, wide, and encased in a metallic frame with heavy 3D beveling and realistic reflections.

verificationChecks: Is the sunburst centered behind the group?
Does the chrome logo have a convincing metallic texture?
Are the colors highly saturated and vibrant?
Is the typography wide and bold?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals

mustAchieve: Clean radial symmetry in the background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chrome logo does not overlap the subjects' heads.
Check that the sunburst rays are straight and originate from a single point.
Verify the 3D depth of the lettering is consistent across all characters.
Confirm the color palette remains in the warm orange/yellow spectrum for the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Color A] and [Color B] radial sunburst with a [Material Type] [Shape] emblem containing [Font Style] typography, positioned above a [Subject Type] group portrait.
